mapper.select: select r.id, r.reviewId, r.storeId, r.reporterId, r.reason, r.status, r.createTime, v.content as reviewContent, s.name as storeName from report r left join review v on v.id = r.reviewId left join store s on s.id = r.storeId where r.status = '待处理' order by r.createTime desc

select r.id, r.reviewId, r.storeId, r.reporterId, r.reason, r.status, r.createTime, v.content as reviewContent, s.name as storeName from report r left join review v on v.id = r.reviewId left join store s on s.id = r.storeId where r.storeId = #{storeId} order by r.createTime desc

select r.id, r.reviewId, r.storeId, r.reporterId, r.reason, r.status, r.createTime, v.content as reviewContent, s.name as storeName from report r left join review v on v.id = r.reviewId left join store s on s.id = r.storeId where r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into report(reviewId, storeId, reporterId, reason, status) values(#{reviewId}, #{storeId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason}, '待处理')
mapper.update: update report set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from report where reviewId = #{reviewId}
